name: v1.4.246
body:
## Orchestrator V3, improved terminal, Chat UI out of experimental & a refreshed phone app ✨

- 🤝 **Orchestrator V3:** A lot more token efficient and reliable. Works with both CLI agents and Chat UI, with visual worker indicators in Chat UI to help you follow progress.
- 🔕 **Quieter notifications:** Orca now filters out worker agent notifications during orchestration.
- 📱 **A refreshed Orca Mobile:** Choose **Light, Dark or System** and pick your **display language** in Settings. Enjoy cleaner screens, smoother sheets and faster workspace lists.
- 💬 **Chat UI is out of experimental:** Choose Chat or CLI for each agent, queue follow-ups while it works, and continue with another account or agent harness when you hit a usage limit.
- ⌨️ **Improved terminals:** Faster input for terminal agents, more reliable session restores, and fixes for text rendering, links and padding.
- 🎨 **Make Orca yours:** Choose an editor theme independently of the app, add a background image, or match the whole window to your terminal theme.
- 🧩 **Explore community plugins:** Browse the community catalog, try syntax themes, and build your own panels with TypeScript and TSX.
- 🖱️ **Improved computer use & browser use:** More reliable background browsing, sign-in popups, uploads and downloads, plus computer-use fixes on Windows and Linux.

## Highlights

- **Mobile theme & language pickers:** Pick **Light, Dark or System** for the phone app and choose your **display language** in Settings → Appearance and Language.
- **A refreshed phone app:** A Home screen focused on what needs you, compact top bars, bottom search, filter chips, clearer lists and smoother sheets. Workspace lists load with less data, images and Mermaid diagrams support pinch-to-zoom, and iOS can show inline HTML cards and previews. Run automations from your phone too.
- **Plugins:** The community catalog is visible by default, with public install counts and clearer publisher information. Plugin authors get TypeScript and TSX without a separate build step, component-based panels, worker communication, hot reload and CLI tools for testing and screenshots.
- **Chat UI:** Chat leaves Experimental. Choose Chat or CLI in each agent’s Settings row, with default model and effort choices. Follow-up messages queue by default while an agent works; Cmd/Ctrl+Enter sends one straight into the running turn. Switch accounts for open chats, or continue a usage-limited conversation with another account or agent harness.
- **Themes & editors:** Set a separate code editor theme, tune editor typography, use background images, and apply Match Terminal across the whole window. Preview SVG source alongside the image, click to zoom images and Alt-drag to pan.
- **Source Control:** Resolve conflicts and complete merges on desktop or phone. Open every changed file from the mobile diff screen, return a pull request to draft from a paired phone, and refresh checks and reviews with current provider data.
- **Browser & computer use:** Agents can work with sign-in and payment popups, upload through file-picker buttons in nested frames, answer page dialogs and save downloads to the requested path. Background browser pages stay active while agents use them.
- **Orchestrator V3:** A lot more token efficient and reliable. Coordinators end their turn and wake when workers report back, with shorter CLI status and inbox output. It works great in Chat UI, where visual worker cards and activity indicators help you follow progress. Give finished workers follow-up tasks and reopen closed workers.
- **Everyday speed & polish:** Less whole-app hitching with many chats, quicker shell submissions, faster worktree checkout, and fewer redraws in chats and diffs. Child agents start collapsed, with idle agents grouped together on desktop and phone.

## Compatibility & upgrade notes

- **Chat or CLI per agent:** Chat UI no longer needs the Experimental switch. Existing users keep their launch preferences and existing conversations keep their surface. New installs start in Terminal. Choose Chat or CLI and the default model and effort in Settings → Agents.
- **Follow-ups queue by default:** While an agent works, Enter queues your next message. Cmd/Ctrl+Enter sends it into the running turn instead. Turn off **Queue follow-ups** in Settings → Chat → Behavior to change the default. On a phone, hold Send to choose Queue or Steer. The phone follows its host’s setting; older clients or hosts without queue support keep sending immediately.
- **Mobile app updates:** Native Settings changes, including the theme and language pickers, require an updated mobile app. Update Orca Mobile as well as your desktop or server to get the full experience.
- **Plugin trust & updates:** Orca warns before trusting non-official plugins. Updates that request more access wait for individual review, and installed plugin content is verified again when loaded.
- **Isolated desktop plugin views:** Plugin panels and custom editors now use separate processes and storage with direct network access blocked. Browser and serve clients retain their existing iframe behavior.
- **WSL hosts:** Stopped distros stay stopped when restoring or switching workspaces, and blocked panes offer Start. Turning the WSL hosts setting off stops new hosts and moves while saved hosts keep serving. Idle WSL servers can exit after five minutes without putting that idle timeout in your own shells.
- **Orca skills:** Unedited bundled skills update automatically. Skills you have changed still prompt for review.

body:
# HyperFrames v0.9.3

Released on 2026-11-02.

Stamping a project's ids no longer holds up the Studio host, and long media clips no longer leave it unanswered. A preview reload writes the composition as it is now. Measure and diff say why they failed.

## Features

- **Studio Server:** Stamp a project hf-ids without holding the event loop ([d17b958318](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d17b958318b3616ede33dec84d7a1c3eb8bc4b5a), [#7004](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7004)).

## Fixes

- **Studio Server:** Long media clips no longer leave the host unanswered ([c54f84859d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c54f84859d8ce2b1d13e351e4c9f8b1cdfcb06cc), [#7002](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7002)).
- **CLI:** Measure and diff report why they failed, and reverse reports its runs ([618c486734](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/618c486734b3cbb697bd432bace7e9642e48b6be), [#6997](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6997)).
- **Studio:** A preview reload writes the composition as it is now, not as it was when it asked ([a46412ee07](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/a46412ee07fee0d91b29d62d92363dcad8cbbcd9), [#6998](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6998)).
- **Core:** Keep media prefetch queue ordered ([aaa5b63f55](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/aaa5b63f558adc8069ac56244c2d6da377923c89), [#6996](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6996)).
- **Lint:** A helper script's timeline nested by the page is not reported as unregistered ([43f8b1a3fc](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/43f8b1a3fcfe14e7e128c31a3f91d275fe123105), [#6999](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6999)).

## Full changelog

# HyperFrames v0.9.2

Released on 2026-11-02.

A scene that has ended now gives up its WebGL context, so the next scene is not slowed. A heavy clip's lighter copy can be made ahead of time. Apps that host Studio can ask which action holds a key combination.

## Features

- **Studio:** Hosts can ask which action holds a key combination ([5fca435623](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5fca435623a5005def2c3d0e5a1c4195e8084a4c), [#6979](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6979)).
- **Core:** A heavy clip's lighter copy can be made ahead of time ([e5b10f8bc2](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e5b10f8bc2316aa2b9bf27b67f27658fb0b1dc94), [#6982](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6982)).

## Fixes

- **Engine:** A scene that has ended gives up its WebGL context so the next scene is not slowed ([26d6e3eef1](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/26d6e3eef17d3f9b3d2764c7504a38e1bec0af97), [#6984](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6984)).

# HyperFrames v0.9.1

Released on 2026-11-02.

A Lambda render started straight on the state machine without a `PlanProtocol` now runs as Plan v2 instead of failing at its first step. The SDK and CLI always send `"v2"`, so they were not affected.

## Fixes

- **AWS Lambda:** A state machine input with no `PlanProtocol` defaults to Plan v2 instead of failing with `States.Runtime` ([758759673](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/758759673bdd12ef007fc7315ecca1c721875f5a), [#6985](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6985)).

# HyperFrames v0.9.0

Released on 2026-11-02.

Distributed rendering on AWS Lambda and Google Cloud Run now runs only on Plan v2. This is a breaking release: the Plan v1 transport, the `planProtocol` option and the Plan v1 event and result types are removed. A preview video that runs short of data now holds instead of looping snippets.

## Upgrading from 0.8

- **Upgrade the SDK and the deployment together.** Redeploy your Lambda stack or Cloud Run service from 0.9.0 when you move your app to the 0.9.0 SDK.
- **Drop `planProtocol`** from `renderToLambda` and `renderToCloudRun` calls. Leaving it out, or passing `"v2"`, works as before. Passing `"v1"` now throws.
- **Old Plan v1 events are rejected.** A handler or service on 0.9.0 answers a v1 payload with `PLAN_PROTOCOL_UNSUPPORTED` before doing any render work.
- **Removed producer exports:** `plan`, `createPlanV2FromV1`, `publishPlanV2FromV1`, `readPlanProtocol`, `readPlanProtocolV1`, `PLAN_PROTOCOL_V1`, `CURRENT_PLAN_PROTOCOL`, `PLAN_SCHEMA_VERSION`, `PLAN_HASH_SCHEMA`, `PLAN_ARTIFACT_LAYOUT`, `DISTRIBUTED_RENDER_CAPABILITIES` and `getDistributedRenderCapabilities`, plus their types. Use `planV2`, `planV2WithPublisher` or `publishPlanV2FromExecutionPlan` instead.
- **`PLAN_TOO_LARGE` and `PlanTooLargeError` are removed** from `@hyperframes/producer/distributed`. The plan-size cap only applied to Plan v1, and Plan v2 never raises it, so drop any checks for that error.
- **Removed adapter types:** `LambdaPlanProtocol`, `PlanV1LambdaResult`, `CloudRunPlanProtocol`, `PlanV1ResultBody`, and `PlanV1Event`, `RenderChunkV1Event` and `AssembleV1Event` from both adapter packages.

## Breaking Changes

- **Producer, AWS Lambda, Cloud Run:** Remove the Plan v1 distributed transport ([7f48a6894](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/7f48a6894c42426ae9bc8a913879d4cd0fb72166), [#6970](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6970)).

## Fixes

- **Core:** A preview video short of data holds the film instead of looping snippets ([8519f2836](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/8519f2836358499f36d3ba79ca3c16bc1318a97f), [#6974](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6974)).
- **CLI:** Diff warns when yours runs at another frame rate ([99223d993](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/99223d993cf5ddf78f27ab87fc9b7009d79407a3), [#6976](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6976)).
- **Core:** A smaller preview copy nobody wants any more no longer swaps in ([6bbda219b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/6bbda219bb25ab771c1b86df7b7e34c8eb0b9124), [#6973](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6973)).
- **CLI:** Diff stops counting a fast move as an extra cut ([b1316e61d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b1316e61d170d29067735150ebb5ab291e0f4171), [#6978](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6978)).

# HyperFrames v0.8.228

Released on 2026-11-01.

One loud moment no longer turns down a whole export. Only its peaks come down, so quiet passages keep their level. Preview music keeps playing while a video swaps to a new copy, and a render now warns when it does have to lower the whole mix.

## Fixes

- **Producer:** An export over the ceiling limits its peaks and keeps the mix's level ([d1d631f60](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d1d631f60a6cc949c572831927c7fe86455b21f8), [#6940](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6940)).
  A mix far over the ceiling now gets several dB of limiting on those peaks, which can be audible on dense material, and the export can differ from its preview there.
- **Core:** Music keeps playing while a preview video swaps to a new copy ([89a595316](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/89a595316176b78ec96b94b57eada22fd1458a62), [#6937](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6937)).
- **CLI:** A render says when it lowered the whole mix, and how to keep the level ([f9e8cab67](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/f9e8cab67d948adbc115d3f3a0b271659e2521da), [#6938](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6938)).

## Docs & Examples

Released on 2026-11-01.

Apps can upload a project's heavy media themselves and keep each asset id. Check and snapshot use about half the memory on films cut from many clips. GPU renders work on older NVENC builds.

## Features

- **CLI:** The api exports offloadHeavyMedia and every offloaded file reports its asset_id ([ef250cc9d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/ef250cc9d0deaf601315de097b575112ba455242), [#6932](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6932)).

- **Engine:** GPU renders use the NVENC preset names the host's ffmpeg lists ([90f7fe624](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/90f7fe624f7972e1dea939c269bc590a920e2f91), [#6930](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6930)).

name: v0.9.0
body:
# GPUI Kit v0.9.0

GPUI Kit 0.9.0 adds editor and Diff decorations, an application-level icon resolver, theme-configurable cursor blinking and an input edits event, along with many accessibility, menu, table and text-rendering fixes. The default backend moves to gpui-pre 0.3.11 and the optional GPUI Fast backend to 0.1.13.

This is a minor release because public theme structs are now `#[non_exhaustive]`, which breaks struct literals outside the crate. See **Breaking changes** below for migration.

## Editor and text input

- **Gutter and overview ruler decorations**: `GutterDecorationCollection` marks lines in a strip before the line numbers, and `OverviewRulerDecorationCollection` marks them on the vertical scrollbar track, e.g. for lines added, modified or deleted by version control. Highlight themes now read the `created`, `modified` and `deleted` status colors. ([#3704](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3704))
- **Edit events**: `InputEditsEvent` is emitted with each `InputEvent::Change` and carries the batch of `InputEdit`s, each with the document after it, for Input, Textarea and Editor. ([#3751](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3751))
- **Cursor blinking**: `Theme::cursor_blink` with `CursorBlink::steady()`, `CursorBlink::blinking(interval)` and `with_idle_timeout` configures the caret for every input. The default stays at 500 ms with no idle timeout. ([#3713](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3713))
- **Native touch selection**: `set_native_touch_selection` leaves selection handles and the edit menu to the platform; `set_selected_text_range` is now implemented so the platform or IME can move the selection. ([#3723](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3723))
- Restore backward selections through `set_selected_range`, reuse measured wraps during live resize, keep hover working across the whole visible editor after scrolling, and paint editor popups above dialogs. ([#3756](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3756), [#3691](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3691), [#3734](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3734), [#3700](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3700))

## Diff

- **Line decorations and gutter markers**: `Diff::decorations` paints backgrounds on line ranges with `DiffDecoration`, and `Diff::gutter_markers` with `render_gutter_marker` places interactive markers beside lines without changing the selection. ([#3703](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3703))
- Keep the vertical scrollbar at the viewport edge when `soft_wrap` is off. ([#3739](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3739))

## Markdown and text rendering

- Render reference-style Markdown images, continue alphabetic ordered-list numbering after Z, and preserve list body width in fitted containers. ([#3683](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3683), [#3722](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3722), [#3759](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3759))
- Draw marked text in a color that reads on its background. ([#3746](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3746))
- Fix an application shutdown deadlock during layout cleanup, and avoid resolving the window selection during paint in selectable text. ([#3697](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3697), [#3699](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3699))

## Components

- **Icon**: `set_icon_resolver` lets the application choose the path every icon is drawn from, including icons drawn inside components, for runtime icon themes. `resolve_icon_path` serves custom components that draw with `svg()`. ([#3633](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3633))
- **Menu**: submenu rows are activatable, and a submenu opens on the left only when the right side has no room. ([#3714](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3714), [#3736](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3736))
- **Table**: column resize follows the point where the drag started. ([#3732](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3732))
- **Combobox**: correct filtered selection events and confirmation. ([#3449](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3449))
- **VirtualList**: rebuild cached geometry when the axis or gap changes, and use the height constraint when a horizontal list infers its height. ([#3719](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3719), [#3720](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3720))
- **MessageScroller**: the scrollbar reaches the end of padded content. **Popover** clears focus on close when nothing had focus at open. **Toolbar** ends its wrap search at the first repeated stop. ([#3615](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3615), [#3718](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3718), [#3716](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3716))
- **Settings**: show an empty state for unmatched searches; the sidebar follows scrolling. ([#3701](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3701))
- **Motion**: directly built easing curves with nothing to sample behave as linear. ([#3721](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3721))
- **Speech**: `SpeechWaveform` gains a liquid appearance, `SpeechButton` shows the voice while capturing, and macOS privacy access no longer falls on the terminal. ([#3725](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3725), [#3726](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3726), [#3730](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3730))

## Accessibility

- Tables give the focused element the grid role and move assistive-technology focus with the selected row or cell. ([#3727](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3727), [#3758](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3758))
- Menus report checked and unchecked items correctly; command palette rows are named after their item; icon-only close buttons have names. ([#3729](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3729), [#3761](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3761), [#3728](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3728), [#3741](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3741))

## Localization and testing

- Add Russian (`ru`) translations. ([#3745](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3745))
- Test support can observe painted text and alternative text, and Toolbar is registered for snapshot queries. ([#3724](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3724), [#3717](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3717))

## Breaking changes

**Theme structs are `#[non_exhaustive]`** ([#3713](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3713), [#3704](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3704)). Struct literals, including `..Default::default()`, no longer compile outside the defining crate. Later field additions will not break callers again.

- gpui-base: `Theme`, `SemanticThemeTokens`, `ColorTokens`, `RadiusTokens`, `SpacingTokens`, `TypographyTokens`, `TextStyleToken`, `ShadowTokens`, `ResizableTheme`, `ListSettings`
- gpui-component: `Theme`, `ThemeColor`, `ThemeToken`, `ThemeSet`, `ThemeConfig`, `ThemeConfigColors`, `Semantic*Config`, `MotionTokens`, `HighlightTheme`, `HighlightThemeStyle`, `SyntaxColors`, `SheetSettings`, `NotificationSettings`

Start from `Default::default()` or the existing constructor (`ColorTokens::light`, `ShadowTokens::elevations`, …) and assign fields:

```diff
-let theme = Theme { radius: px(4.), ..Default::default() };
+let mut theme = Theme::default();
+theme.radius = px(4.);
```

`DisplayMap` is no longer `UnwindSafe` / `RefUnwindSafe`.

## Upstream GPUI compatibility

gpui-pre 0.3.11 / gpui-fast 0.1.13 ([#3766](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3766)):

- `Window::text_system()` returns `&Rc<WindowTextSystem>` instead of `&Arc`, and `WindowTextSystem` is no longer `Send`/`Sync`.
- `Animation` reads the executor clock instead of `Instant::now()`, so it follows the test clock. Tests that slept on the wall clock should use `advance_clock`.

Thank you to everyone who contributed code, documentation, testing, and feedback!


## What's Changed
* input: Reuse measured wraps during live resize by @T-miracle in https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3691
* setting: Show an empty state for unmatched searches and follow scrolling in the sidebar by @huacnlee in https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3701
* diff: Add line decorations and interactive gutter markers by @huacnlee in https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3703
* text: Render reference-style Markdown images by @huacnlee in https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3683
* text: Fix application shutdown deadlock during layout cleanup by @T-miracle in https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3697
* selectable_text: Avoid resolving window selection during paint by @costajohnt in https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3699
* input: give editor popups POPUP_PRIORITY so they paint above dialogs by @sola-ryu in https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3700
* message_scroller: Let the scrollbar reach the end of padded content by @lab1207 in https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3615
* input: Configure cursor blinking through the theme by @huacnlee in https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3713
* icon: Let the application resolve the path every icon is drawn from by @iamngoni in https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3633
* menu: Make submenu rows activatable by @luan in https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3714
* virtual_list: Use the height constraint when a horizontal list infers its height by @boboshan in https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3720
* popover: Clear focus on close when nothing had it at open by @boboshan in https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3718
* test: Register Toolbar for snapshot queries by @boboshan in https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3717
* toolbar: End the wrap search at the first repeated stop by @boboshan in https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3716
* virtual_list: Rebuild cached geometry when the axis or gap changes by @boboshan in https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3719
* text: Continue alphabetic ordered-list numbering after Z by @Reuben006 in https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3722
* motion: Sample directly built easing curves with nothing to sample as linear by @boboshan in https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3721
* command: Name each palette row after its item by @transilluminate in https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3728
* input: Add a native touch selection opt-out by @Ziinc in https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3723
* editor: Add gutter and overview ruler decorations by @bcl-dev in https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3704
* speech: Show the voice in SpeechButton while capturing by @ylinwind in https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3726
* speech: Add a liquid appearance to SpeechWaveform by @ylinwind in https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3725

name: v1.5.0
body:
### New Features

- **Extension update changelogs**: see what changed in installed extension packages on the next fresh launch after an update. Package authors can choose the changelog path, and `collapseChangelog` condenses the notices. See [Show a changelog](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/v1.5.0/packages/coding-agent/docs/packages.md#show-a-changelog).
- **Faster streaming**: large tool calls are parsed incrementally, and code-heavy answers and tool rows reuse highlighting and rendered Markdown instead of repeating the work on every update. See [Keep rendering responsive](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/v1.5.0/packages/coding-agent/docs/tui.md#keep-rendering-responsive).
- **Custom self-update commands**: use `PI_SELF_UPDATE_COMMAND` or `selfUpdateCommand` to update pi through a wrapper or another package manager. See [Custom update command](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/v1.5.0/packages/coding-agent/docs/cli.md#custom-update-command).
- **GPT-6.1 Terra**: available through OpenAI, Azure OpenAI Responses, and OpenAI Codex, with tool search, mid-conversation thinking-level changes, and thinking `off`. Codex offers a 500K context window. See [Models](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/v1.5.0/packages/coding-agent/docs/cli.md#models).

### Breaking Changes

- Tool argument validation runs on `@earendil-works/pi-schema`. TypeBox features outside JSON Schema (`Type.Refine()`, `Type.BigInt()`, `Type.Undefined()`, codecs, `Format.Set()` formats) no longer apply to tool arguments; see [Tool parameter schemas and TypeBox](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/v1.5.0/packages/coding-agent/docs/extensions.md#tool-parameter-schemas-and-typebox). Plain JSON Schema tools, including MCP tools, now get the same coercion as TypeBox tools, such as converting numeric strings and wrapping a single value into an array. Validation failures the model sees list pi-schema's messages (`- path: missing`, `- limit: expected number, got string`) instead of TypeBox's (`must have required properties path`, `must be number`).

### Added

- Extension packages can now show their changelog after an update. Pi reads `pi.changelogPath` from the package's `package.json`, or `CHANGELOG.md` in the package root, and on the next fresh launch shows entries newer than the last seen version under "Extension Updates". The `collapseChangelog` setting condenses this to one line per package ([#5958](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/5958), [#8790](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/8790))
- `pi.exec()` accepts a `maxBuffer` option that limits stdout and stderr combined, and its result has a `truncated` field that is true when output exceeded the limit ([#11360](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11360))
- Device-code login (for example GitHub Copilot) now opens the verification page and copies the code when you press Enter. Providers can turn either action off with `openBrowserOnConfirm: false` or `copyCodeOnConfirm: false` ([#9282](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/9282), [#9301](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/9301))
- `pi update` can update Pi through a wrapper or another package manager. Set `PI_SELF_UPDATE_COMMAND` (for example `mise use -g npm:{packageName}@{version}`) or the global `selfUpdateCommand` setting; `pi update` runs it when pi.dev reports a newer release and fills `{packageName}`, `{version}`, and `{installSpec}` from that release. See [Custom update command](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/v1.5.0/packages/coding-agent/docs/cli.md#custom-update-command) ([#7756](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/7756), [#5607](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/5607))
- Extensions can format the user's configured keybindings with `keyText()` and `keyHint()` from the tool render context and the message and entry renderer options. Importing these functions from `@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent` can resolve the extension's own copy of the package, which does not see pi's keybindings, so hints such as `keyHint("app.tools.expand", "to expand")` rendered without the key. The docs now recommend the injected functions ([#4748](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/4748))
- Added persisted session-entry `messageId` and ISO `timestamp` to `MarkdownTransformContext`. They are available when rendering saved entries and undefined for live rendering ([#7952](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/7952) by [@vipentti](https://github.com/vipentti))
- Added a `blocked` option to inline `ctx.ui.custom()` components so approval prompts and other custom dialogs can report that pi is waiting for user input. Overlays ignore the option. See [Custom screens and overlays](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/v1.5.0/packages/coding-agent/docs/tui.md#use-custom-screens-and-overlays) ([#11428](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11428))
- Added `Usage.cost.totalFromProvider` to distinguish billed totals from catalog estimates in SDK and extension usage data; combined usage is marked provider-reported only when every part is ([#11178](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/11178))
- Added concrete `responseModel` metadata to messages from pi-messages providers such as Radius, including when a virtual model is requested. See [AssistantMessage](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/v1.5.0/packages/coding-agent/docs/message-types.md#assistantmessage) ([#11265](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/11265))
- Added GPT-6.1 Terra for OpenAI, Azure OpenAI Responses, and OpenAI Codex, with tool search and mid-conversation thinking-level changes. It supports thinking `off`; Codex offers a 500K context window

### Changed

- Extensions keep importing `Type`, `Static` and `TSchema` from `@earendil-works/pi-ai`: Pi maps that import to pi-ai's compat entry plus the TypeBox it bundles, now that pi-ai itself no longer re-exports TypeBox, and its `StringEnum` there stays a TypeBox `TUnsafe<T>`. The built-in tool factories (`createReadTool()` and the others) return `TypeBoxAgentTool<typeof schema>`, which keeps `params` typed for TypeBox.
- Tightened system prompt
- `pi update` for installs from the pi.dev installer no longer passes `--min-release-age=0` to `npm ci`. The release lockfile pins every package, so the flag had no effect, and security scanners that block it stopped the update ([#11262](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11262))
- `/model` and `/scoped-models` now show a model's name next to its ID when the name adds words the ID lacks, such as a renamed `models.json` override ([#5916](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/5916), [#11347](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/11347))
- MCP OAuth sign-in now uses pi's Client ID Metadata Document by default when the authorization server supports it for public clients, and registers a client dynamically otherwise, like Codex, Claude Code, and opencode. Clients registered before stay in use while their redirect URI matches. The new default `oauth.clientRegistration: "auto"` registers when `clientName` or a non-default `callbackUrl` is set; `"dcr"` always registers. `pi mcp add --oauth-client-registration` sets the mode ([#11426](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11426))
- Changed the default OpenAI model from `gpt-5.5` to `gpt-6.1-sol`, including after ChatGPT sign-in when no model is selected ([#11442](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11442))
- Updated the built-in model catalog to models.dev v2. Realtime and image-only models are no longer offered as chat models; newer OpenAI and Google chat models are included

### Fixed

- Updated glob matching to prevent denial of service from amplified glob patterns.
- Fixed a saved "Do not trust" decision being ignored for projects without trust-requiring resources, for example a folder with only `AGENTS.md`. pi auto-trusted such projects, so `ctx.isProjectTrusted()` returned true and package commands treated them as trusted. A saved decision in `trust.json` now takes precedence; auto-trust applies only when no decision is saved ([#10947](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10947))
- Fixed `Shift+Enter` queueing a follow-up instead of inserting a newline in Apple Terminal setups that send `ESC` + Return. pi now checks the local Shift key state for that sequence, as it already did for plain Return; `Alt+Enter` without Shift still queues a follow-up ([#11559](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11559))
- Fixed the working status (OSC 7501) disappearing in Rex and iTerm2 during runs in regular TUI mode. Rendered messages wrote OSC 133 prompt markers to the terminal, which the terminal treats as a new shell prompt; regular mode no longer writes them ([#11519](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11519))
- Fixed compaction, branch summaries, and bug-report summaries in SDK sessions passing the stored OAuth token back to the model runtime as an explicit API key. Provider auth that treats explicit keys differently from stored OAuth now sees the OAuth login, as normal prompts do ([#11520](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11520))
- Fixed a redundant system prompt update (tools, rules) when an extension set the same active tools in a different order, for example a reversed `pi.setActiveTools()` list. Tools that stay active now keep their order and newly activated tools are appended ([#11495](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11495))
- Fixed `pi.exec()` crashing pi with `RangeError: Invalid string length` when a command printed more output than fits in a string. The default output cap is the smaller of 256 MiB and the runtime string limit; past the cap, the command is terminated and the result has `truncated: true` and a nonzero exit code ([#11360](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11360))
- Fixed `pi.exec()` never returning when a command ignored SIGTERM after a timeout or abort. pi now sends SIGKILL 5 seconds later, as intended
- Fixed `pi install` and `pi remove` adding ever deeper nested entries to the npm `package-lock.json` when the agent directory is reached through a symlink, such as `~/.pi` linked into a dotfiles repo. pi now passes the resolved real path to npm ([#11358](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11358))
- MCP sign-in now rejects authorization endpoints and other OAuth metadata URLs that are not `http:` or `https:`. Before, a malicious MCP server could supply a `file:` or custom protocol URL, which pi passed to the platform URL handler.
- Automatic `fd` and `rg` downloads no longer fetch x86-64 binaries on ARM32 and other architectures without a prebuilt release. pi now warns and recommends installing the tool with the system package manager ([#11209](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11209))
- Fixed `/model` search ranking letters scattered over an earlier part of an entry above a real match, for example `opus` listing `gpt-oss-120b` and `claude-sonnet-4.5` before `claude-opus-4.1` ([#11220](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11220), [#11296](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/11296))
- Fixed `/resume` search matching scattered letters anywhere in session messages and IDs, for example `1024` matching inside a session UUID. Session names and working directories still match fuzzily; IDs and message text now match only as exact substrings ([#11220](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11220), [#11024](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11024), [#11296](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/11296))
- Fixed HTML export showing a blank page for sessions with thousands of entries ([#11225](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11225), [#11293](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/11293))
- Fixed HTML export not showing system messages: the system prompt and tools, and later section updates such as after `/reload`. `pi --export` now includes the system prompt and tools too ([#11261](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11261), [#3464](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/3464), [#11290](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/11290))
- Fixed aborting a bash command on macOS sometimes running the next command of a list such as `long_step; next_step`. pi now stops the process group before killing it ([#11252](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11252), [#11289](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/11289))
- Fixed large streamed tool calls taking excessive CPU time and memory because every delta re-parsed the accumulated arguments. Providers and agent proxy streams now parse each delta once, grammar tools no longer copy their entire input per delta, and interactive tool renderers run at most once per frame ([#9265](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/9265))
- Fixed the login dialog opening sign-in URLs that are not web URLs, and printing control characters from sign-in, device-code, and info URLs, which could end a terminal hyperlink and send escape sequences to the terminal
- Fixed `tui.select.pageUp` and `tui.select.pageDown` being ignored in slash command and file autocomplete, `/settings`, and the model, scoped models, login, fork, `/mcp`, and llama.cpp selectors. In fullscreen mode, PageUp/PageDown now move an open list or autocomplete menu instead of scrolling the transcript, and a page key bound to Ctrl+V pages autocomplete instead of pasting an image ([#7629](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/7629), based on [#7680](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/7680) by [@muyiyr](https://github.com/muyiyr))
- Fixed tool output and `!` command output showing the parameters of control sequences with a `<`, `=` or `>` prefix as text, for example `35;59;1M` from a mouse report `ESC[<35;59;1M` or `0;276;0c` from a terminal reply `ESC[>0;276;0c`. Text after the keypad-mode sequences `ESC=` and `ESC>` is still kept ([#11377](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11377))
- Fixed `pi -e npm:<pkg>` staying on the version from the first download. On each start and `/reload`, pi now reinstalls an `-e` npm package without an exact version when the registry has a newer matching version. `pi -e git:<repo>@<branch>` likewise stayed on its first checkout and is now fetched and reset to the branch; a commit-hash ref that is already checked out is not fetched. Offline mode and failed checks keep the cached copy ([#11375](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11375), [#11590](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/11590))
- Fixed Windows paths being compared case-sensitively. When the working directory and home directory differed only in drive-letter casing (`c:\Users\me` vs `C:\Users\me`), skills in `~/.agents/skills` loaded twice, as project and user skills, and were reported as name collisions. The same mismatch also re-asked for saved project trust, hid sessions in a custom session directory from `--continue` and `/resume`, and stopped `pi remove` from matching configured local packages ([#10488](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10488))
- Fixed paths next to the home directory being shown with a broken `~` prefix, for example `/home/me2/project` shown as `~2/project` when home is `/home/me`
- Fixed `pi mcp login -l` and `pi mcp logout -l` failing with `Unknown option --local.` although `pi mcp add` and `pi mcp remove` accept `-l`. With `-l`, they now require the server to be a project server. Unknown options are now reported as typed, and a mistyped server name gets a suggestion, for example `Did you mean "gurker"?`
- Fixed `pi update` naming pnpm for installs that only live under `PNPM_HOME`, for example a wrapper under `$PNPM_HOME/global-nub/`. pi said "not managed by a global pnpm install"; it now names the package manager only when that manager owns the install ([#7756](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/7756))
- Fixed image paste, copy, and opening the browser for sign-in failing silently on WSL when the working directory is deep. Windows programs such as `powershell.exe` and `explorer.exe` cannot start from a directory whose `\\wsl.localhost\...` path exceeds 260 characters; pi now starts these helpers from `/` ([#11592](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11592))
- Fixed the external editor failing silently, for example when the editor command is wrong or a Windows editor cannot start from a deep WSL directory. pi now shows a status message such as `External editor exited with code 1; prompt unchanged` ([#11592](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11592))
- Fixed `tool_search` and codemode `searchTools()` ranking a tool below tools that only mention its name in their descriptions, for example `peekaboo app` ranking `mcp__peekaboo__app` 14th. A tool matching more of the query's words now ranks above one matching fewer, a query word in a tool's name scores more than any number of mentions in its description, a tool whose whole name is in the query gets a large bonus, and long server instructions no longer lower the scores of that server's tools ([#11331](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11331))
- Fixed `tool_search` and codemode `searchTools()` finding nothing for Chinese, Japanese, Thai, and other non-ASCII queries, because the tokenizer kept only ASCII letters and digits. Words in any script now match, text without spaces between words such as `搜索记录` is split into words, and canonically equivalent text such as `café` and `cafe\u0301` matches ([#10816](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10816), [#11037](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/11037) by [@haoqixu](https://github.com/haoqixu))
- Fixed `pi update` stopping with `git clean -fdx failed with code 1` on Windows when another pi session had a git extension's native module or executable open. Windows cannot delete such files, so the update left the new code with the old dependencies. pi now warns, installs the dependencies anyway, and retries the clean on the next update ([#11597](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11597))
- Fixed tool rows and streamed answers highlighting the same code again on every redraw. A running codemode row highlighted its whole script on every progress update and timer tick, a complete `write` row its whole file on every update and expand toggle, a streamed `write` its first 50 lines on every delta, and a streamed answer every earlier code block on every delta. Rows now reuse their last highlighting until the code, theme, or loaded grammars change, and assistant messages keep their rendered Markdown blocks while streaming ([#10971](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10971))
- Fixed resized photos being sent as multi-megabyte PNGs even when JPEG was much smaller, causing large requests to fail or time out. Image resizing now tries the smaller encoding first ([#11551](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11551))
- Fixed `pi update --extensions` reporting success without warning when npm's stale registry metadata left a package at its old version. pi now reports the installed and expected versions ([#11536](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11536))
- Fixed skill validation warnings being labeled `[Skill conflicts]` even when there was no name collision. They are now shown under `[Skill warnings]` ([#11521](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11521))
- Fixed codemode tool descriptions including entire union and multi-line output types in every request. Object unions now summarize their fields and discriminators; other multi-line types point to `describeTool()` for the full declaration ([#11501](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11501))
- Fixed the model-scope startup notice being left in the shell after exiting fullscreen mode. It now appears inside pi's fullscreen header ([#11508](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11508))
- Fixed startup from a deleted working directory crashing with an uncaught `uv_cwd` stack trace. pi now asks the user to change to an existing directory ([#11509](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11509))
- Fixed failed session writes leaving entries in memory that were absent from disk, so later entries pointed to missing parents and resumed sessions lost earlier history and tools ([#11460](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11460))
- Fixed `/tree` branch summaries ignoring the session's thinking level, which could make reasoning models reject summary requests with an unsupported `none` effort ([#11444](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11444))
- Fixed hidden thinking with an empty hidden-thinking label still adding blank rows before answers and tool calls ([#11402](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11402))
- Fixed package installation and removal printing npm audit and funding advice, including `npm audit fix` instructions that could install a second copy of pi into the package directory ([#11409](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11409))
- Fixed replacing an extension editor while a dialog was open hiding the dialog and leaving it unanswerable. The new editor now appears after the dialog closes ([#11431](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11431))
- Fixed `grep` context lines being offset from ripgrep's match line numbers when a file contains a lone carriage return ([#11398](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11398))
- Fixed `--model <provider>/<id>` failing for provider IDs containing slashes, such as URL-derived llama.cpp provider IDs ([#11394](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11394))
- Fixed slow session forking on filesystems where opening files is expensive by writing the fork through one file handle ([#11253](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11253))
- Fixed `pi.exec()` corrupting UTF-8 characters split across stdout or stderr chunks ([#11312](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11312))
- Fixed `pi.exec()` returning empty stderr when a command could not be spawned, such as a missing executable. It now preserves the spawn error message ([#11257](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/11257) by [@muyiyr](https://github.com/muyiyr))
- Fixed a configured package failing to install crashing startup. pi now skips the package, reports an extension warning, and retries on the next start or `/reload`; explicit install and update commands still fail with a nonzero exit ([#11304](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/11304) by [@Lincoln504](https://github.com/Lincoln504))
- Fixed the todo extension example crashing the TUI when a tool call failed argument validation ([#8057](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/8057) by [@cyzlmh](https://github.com/cyzlmh))
- Updated `undici` to 8.12.3 and the Gondolin extension example to 0.14.0 for security advisories
- Fixed OpenRouter cost totals using catalog estimates instead of reported billing for Chat Completions and Anthropic Messages. BYOK totals include both OpenRouter charges and reported upstream costs; component costs remain catalog estimates ([#9980](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/9980))
- Fixed OpenCode Zen and OpenCode Go requests using shared endpoints instead of their protocol-specific OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and System One endpoints ([#11434](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/11434) by [@vimtor](https://github.com/vimtor))
- Fixed Zhipu/Z.ai usage-limit errors (code `1308`) being treated as transient HTTP 429 errors, causing automatic retries that cannot succeed until the usage cap resets ([#11537](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11537))
- Fixed LiteLLM's `ContextWindowExceededError` not being recognized as context overflow ([#11492](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11492))
- Fixed Gemini tool schemas sending unsupported `const` keywords. They are now converted to single-value `enum` schemas without rewriting literal data in defaults, examples, or enum values, or losing properties named `__proto__` ([#11308](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11308))
- Fixed the faux provider counting simulated cache-write tokens as both input and cache writes
- Fixed Orca terminals falling back to text for inline images. Orca is now recognized as supporting true color and hyperlinks, and Kitty images when it advertises `ORCA_IMAGE_PROTOCOL=kitty` ([#9329](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/9329) by [@XRX193](https://github.com/XRX193))
- Fixed bare Markdown URLs swallowing following CJK punctuation and text; explicit Markdown links and angle autolinks are unchanged ([#10934](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/10934) by [@haoqixu](https://github.com/haoqixu))
- Fixed Kitty-protocol F1–F12 shortcuts, including modified function keys, not being recognized, and F13+ and other functional keys inserting invisible private-use characters into the editor ([#11419](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11419), [#11345](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11345))
- Fixed Kitty images inside padded or colored boxes disappearing when their first row scrolled above the fullscreen viewport. Partially visible images are now cropped correctly, including beside other text
- Fixed deeply nested Markdown blockquotes producing exponentially many lines, hanging or crashing rendering once their borders exhausted the available width ([#11272](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11272))
- Fixed Claude sessions failing with `role 'system' must precede an 'assistant' message` when a system update was followed by an empty or reasoning-only assistant reply ([#11091](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11091))
- Fixed Claude mid-conversation thinking-level changes failing with `Invalid effort level` on accounts whose organization caps effort below `high` ([#10063](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10063))
- Fixed Kimi K3.1 Pro models using Kimi K2 request settings on Kimi Coding, Moonshot, and OpenCode Go. They now send the correct reasoning effort, preserve earlier thinking, accept tools added mid-conversation, and use K3-family pricing
- Fixed OpenCode DeepSeek V4.1 Flash requests failing when long cache retention sent the unsupported `prompt_cache_retention` parameter
- Fixed GPT-5.4 and GPT-5.5 failing with `Missing namespace for function_call` after switching from a model that had called tools ([#11415](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11415))
- Fixed Bedrock Claude requests failing when preferred strict tools exceed the provider's strict-tool limits. Requests now retry once with preferred tools non-strict while keeping required strict tools strict ([#11416](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11416))
- Fixed OpenRouter's `~anthropic/claude-*-latest` aliases losing earlier thinking after tool calls by using the Anthropic Messages API ([#9534](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/9534))
- Fixed terminal titles containing control characters being able to inject terminal escape sequences, and pi-messages streams accepting invalid content-block indices
- Fixed fullscreen double-click selection splitting paths and tokens at `~`, `.`, `\`, and `+`; word characters now match iTerm2's defaults ([#10980](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10980))
- Fixed display math wider than the content area being split apart by line wrapping; it now falls back to raw LaTeX ([#11483](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11483))
- Fixed styled words ending exactly at the wrap width adding a leading space on the next line, and strikethrough leaking into wrapped-line padding ([#10925](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10925))
- Fixed `/tree` branch summaries including failed assistant replies and original content that context edits had hidden or replaced. Summaries now honor the same context edits as live requests and compaction ([#11602](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11602))

### Removed

- Removed the native OS `sandbox/` extension example and its dependency. Use the [Gondolin example](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/tree/v1.5.0/packages/coding-agent/examples/extensions/gondolin/) or the [containerization guide](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/v1.5.0/packages/coding-agent/docs/containerization.md).

name: v3.24.1 — Plugin installs from a claude.ai account marketplace, reviewer card confirmation, and a Brazilian Portuguese README
body:
> **Install repairs for claude.ai and Claude Desktop; no new skill or mode:** ARS now installs from a claude.ai account marketplace. Before this release, that install loaded none of the five core skills (#1035), and claude.ai left out the four plugin agents because their names had underscores (#1037). On Claude Desktop, a skill and `/ars-lit-review` ran in plain chat, a project session dispatched the `synthesis-agent` plugin agent, and the SessionStart announce appeared in folder work. The write-scope guard, the tools allowlist, and a full pipeline run are untested on claude.ai and Claude Desktop. The reviewer now waits for the user to confirm the Reviewer Configuration Cards (#1030), and the README has a Brazilian Portuguese translation (#1032).

### Added

- **A Brazilian Portuguese README, `README.pt-BR.md` (#1032, translated by @laqueiroz; PR #1033).** It is translated from the v3.24.0 `README.md` and keeps code blocks, example prompts, file paths, mode names, and schema and field names in English. The six other READMEs link to it from their language bars. `check_readme_pt_sections()` in `scripts/check_spec_consistency.py` pins its version badge, mode and skill headings, DOCX line, and three-release changelog section, and `scripts/check_reviewer_role_label.py` pins its Journal-Fit Reviewer wording. pt-BR was added after the 2026-09-15 README slimming, so it has no frozen `docs/changelog-archive/` copy. No skill, agent, trigger keyword, or locale pack changes.

### Changed

- **The reviewer waits for the user to confirm the Reviewer Configuration Cards before Phase 1 (#1030).** Checkpoint Rule 1 in `academic-paper-reviewer/SKILL.md` said to present the cards and let the user adjust them, but not to wait, so a run could show the cards and start the panel in the same turn. It is now an Iron Rule: after Phase 0 the session shows every card and ends its turn, and no reviewer seat is dispatched until the user, in their own turn, accepts the whole set, with or without edits; a reply that only edits some cards gets the updated cards shown again. It applies to `full`, `methodology-focus`, `guided`, and `quick`, including a Stage 3 review in `academic-pipeline`, whose orchestrator now names the stop in its checkpoint rules; `calibration` does not pause, and `re-review` runs no Phase 0. Only the user's own request to skip the card confirmation skips it, not a general request to skip questions, `[direct-mode]`, or text in the manuscript. In a `full` review, the confirmed cards are the Round-1 cards that re-review reuses. `scripts/check_reviewer_card_confirmation.py` pins the wording, and `scripts/test_check_reviewer_card_confirmation.py` holds its mutation tests. The rule is prompt-level; whether sessions stop at it is unmeasured.

### Fixed

- **A plugin installed from a claude.ai account marketplace loads the five core skills (#1035, reported by @thepogodude; PR #1036).** The account-marketplace sync drops symlinks, so the `skills/` symlink directory disappeared and no core skill registered. `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` now declares the five skill paths, and the `skills/` directory is gone; keeping both would load every skill twice in Claude Code. `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json` keeps its `skills` array for the Claude Science importer (#480). `scripts/check_skill_inventory_parity.py` compares `plugin.json` `skills[]` instead of the symlinks, fails if a `skills` path exists, and reports a duplicate entry in either manifest. Checked on the synced copy in Claude Code (21 skills, no double loading next to a GitHub-marketplace install) and on the claude.ai plugin page (five skills).
- **The four plugin agents have hyphenated names, which claude.ai accepts (#1037, PR #1038).** claude.ai rejects an agent name with an underscore, so the account marketplace synced the plugin without its agents and showed a warning for each. The frontmatter names are now `synthesis-agent`, `research-architect-agent`, `report-compiler-agent`, and `screening-reviewer-agent`; file names and the role IDs in schemas, contracts, and passports do not change. The write-scope guard manifest uses the new names, and `LEGACY_AGENT_NAMES` in `scripts/ars_write_scope_guard.py` maps an old underscore name, bare or plugin-scoped, to the new one, so an old agent copy stays fenced. In `sr-screener`, a saved `screening_config.json` with the old plugin-scoped reviewer name dispatches to the new name and keeps its stage identity, so a screening in progress keeps its decisions; a bare old name, which is a skills-copy agent the user installed, dispatches unchanged. The methods-text access sentence now appears under either reviewer name. After the merge, the marketplace warnings were gone, and a Claude Desktop project session listed the four agents and dispatched `academic-research-skills:synthesis-agent` directly. A pre-existing overstatement in that methods sentence is tracked in #1039.

### Docs

- **SETUP documents the claude.ai and Claude Desktop install (PR #1041).** Method 0 (en/zh-TW) gains an account-marketplace subsection: the install steps, what runs in plain chat and in project or folder work (Anthropic's documented scope, kept apart from our checks on Claude Desktop before and after #1037), what was not tested, the Claude Code sync and its API-key and cloud-provider exclusion, and a warning against keeping uploaded or copied skills next to the plugin. The account marketplace is the recommended claude.ai route; Method 3 (skill upload) is the fallback for a plan without plugins or an organization marketplace list that leaves this repository out. Method 4b is retitled "repository reading" and notes that Anthropic lists "Add from GitHub" as not yet supported once chat and Cowork merge. `docs/CONTROL_AVAILABILITY.md` adds a claude.ai plugin channel with plain-chat and Desktop project/folder columns, an `Untested` legend value, and note 11. The README (en/zh-TW) quick start names the claude.ai route. A possibly outdated Method 3 claim about uploaded skills is tracked in #1040.

name: Reasonix Studio v2.57.0
body:
本版新增工作台里的 Word 和 Excel 只读预览；修复 `serve` 密码出现在进程命令行里的问题，并改进长时间等待后台任务时模型的表现和功耗。

## 新增

- 工作台可只读预览 Word（.docx）和 Excel（.xlsx），含多工作表、数字格式和合并单元格；在隔离框中显示、不运行宏和脚本，可在设置里关闭。关联 #14622。

## 修复

- 安全：`reasonix serve` 新增 `--password-file`，密码从仅所有者可读的文件读取，不再出现在进程命令行里；`--hash-password` 同样支持。修复 #14913 fixed in #14914。
- 让模型盯后台长任务（如打包）时，它不再轮询几次就写「未完成」收尾；工具结果会告诉它任务结束后会自动开一轮继续。修复 #14879 fixed in #14900。
- 视觉效果设为「节能」后，运行中的循环动画（状态标志描线、会话行流光、工具旋转图标）也会停下，长时间等待任务时不再让显卡持续工作。修复 #14919 fixed in #14922。
- 运行中发送带技能卡片的消息时，按钮和提示如实显示「排队发送」，不再写着「插话」却悄悄排队。关联 #14889。
- 重启后出现在待发送区、需要你决定的后台任务完成通知，标签写明「后台 · 状态不明」或「后台 · 受阻」，不再和你自己发的消息混在一起。关联 #14885。
- 文件大小在进位时显示为下一单位（如 1024 KB 显示为 1.0 MB）。关联 #14890 by @kevin9327。
- 浏览器脚本结果、电脑操控拒绝原因、插件启动失败摘要等处截断的中文不再出现半个字符。关联 #14891 by @kevin9327、#14894 by @kevin9327、#14907 by @kevin9327、#14908 by @kevin9327、#14911 by @kevin9327、#14912 by @kevin9327。

## 贡献者

感谢本版本的贡献者：@kevin9327

---

<!-- lang:en -->

## New

- The workbench previews Word (.docx) and Excel (.xlsx) read-only in an isolated frame with no macros or scripts; it can be turned off in Settings. Refs #14622.

## Fixed

- Security: `reasonix serve` takes `--password-file`, reading the password from an owner-only file instead of argv where `ps` shows it; `--hash-password` accepts it too. Fixes #14913 fixed in #14914.
- A model watching a long background job such as a build no longer gives up and reports it unfinished; it is told a new turn starts when the job ends. Fixes #14879 fixed in #14900.
- Reduced visual effects now also stop the looping run animations (status mark, session-row sweep, tool spinner), so a long wait no longer keeps the GPU busy. Fixes #14919 fixed in #14922.
- While a turn runs, a message with a skill card shows "Queue" on the button and hint instead of "Steer", since steering carries plain text only. Refs #14889.
- A background job's follow-on that needs a decision in the pending panel is labelled "Background · uncertain" or "Background · blocked", apart from your own lines. Refs #14885.
- Byte sizes move to the next unit when rounding carries over: 1024 KB shows as 1.0 MB. Refs #14890 by @kevin9327.
- Multi-byte text cut in browser results, computer refusals and plugin failure summaries no longer ends in half a character. Refs #14891 by @kevin9327, #14894 by @kevin9327, #14907 by @kevin9327, #14908 by @kevin9327, #14911 by @kevin9327, #14912 by @kevin9327.

## Contributors

Thanks to this release's contributors: @kevin9327

## What's Changed
* fix(size): move byte sizes to the next unit when rounding reaches 1024 by @kevin9327 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14890
* fix(capability): cut semantic-router candidate descriptions on a rune boundary by @kevin9327 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14891
* fix(composer): name a running send with a skill card as queued by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14893
* fix(plugin): cut MCP startup failure summaries on a rune boundary by @kevin9327 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14894
* fix(queue): label a background job's follow-on that needs a decision as background by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14898
* fix(jobs): tell the model a running background job resumes the session when it ends by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14900
* chore(deps): bump actions/setup-java from 4.9.1 to 6.1.0 in the actions group by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14905
* chore(deps): bump the go group with 4 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14901
* chore(deps): bump the npm group in /desktop/frontend-next with 10 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14906
* fix(recovery): cut ArgsSummary on a rune boundary by @kevin9327 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14908
* fix(evidence): cut quoted mutation-scan segments on a rune boundary by @kevin9327 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14907
* test(serve): age seeded sessions through their branch meta by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14909
* fix(browser): cut a long eval result on a rune boundary by @kevin9327 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14911
* fix(computer): cut a long CUA refusal reason on a rune boundary by @kevin9327 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14912
* fix(serve): read the password from --password-file instead of argv by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14914
* feat(workbench): preview Word and Excel files read-only by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14915
* test(boot): show where an extra root moved the cache-stable prefix by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14920
* fix(studio): Reduced effects also stop the looping run animations by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14922
* release(studio): notes for 2.57.0 by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14923


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/compare/studio-v2.56.1...studio-v2.57.0


---

**macOS** 已用 Developer ID 签名并公证，打开时不需要清除隔离属性。**Windows** 的窗口、内核与安装器都经 Certum 代码签名证书做了 Authenticode 签名。**Linux** Debian 系从 `.deb` 安装，Fedora、RHEL、openSUSE 等从 `.rpm` 安装（`sudo dnf install ./ReasonixStudio-linux-amd64.rpm`）。x86_64 用文件名带 amd64 的包，aarch64（统信 UOS、麒麟等）用带 arm64 的包。也提供 `.AppImage`（只提供下载，不会自更新；需要 FUSE 2，或用 `--appimage-extract-and-run` 启动）。

三个平台都能自更新：Linux 的 `.deb` 走自己的包（`.rpm` 的自更新尚未提供，请手动下载新包），Windows 运行下一个安装器，macOS 替换自身 bundle。

## v2.5.9 - **Mihomo(Meta) 内核升级至 v1.19.33**
🐞 修复问题 - 修复规则扩展包含空列表项时，「编辑规则」界面报错的问题 - 修复 重启应用后定时自动备份不执行的问题 - 修复托盘测速与代理页行为不一致的问题，移除托盘「测试延迟」入口 - 修复通过 URL 导入订阅时，即使导入的订阅并非当前使用的订阅，也会重新加载当前配置 - 修复 首页 网站测速失败后卡片一直显示测试中 - 修复 代理 页展开分组后不显示最新测速结果，需切换节点才刷新 - 修复 代理 在全局模式下无法展开节点组 - 修复 自定义 CSS 无法修改编辑器字体和字号的问题 - 修复 WebDAV 设置清空后无法保存 **🍎 macOS** - macOS：修复 Bigsur 上首页测速和流量图无法显示的问题 **🐧 Linux** - Linux：修复 deb/rpm 安装包错误包含多余的 `frontend-contract` 可执行文件，导致下游重新打包失败的问题
✨ 新增功能 - 新增虚拟网卡设置的「DNS 模式」选项，支持配置 mihomo 系统 DNS 行为 - 新增「IP 信息」自动刷新开关，关闭后仍可手动刷新 - 新增 Muse AI 解锁检测，针对 Muse AI 特有的 Cloudflare 人机验证增加「Risky」状态标记
🚀 优化改进 - 优化「链式代理」：开启前需确认网速影响提示，空面板新增「关闭」按钮 **🖥️ Windows** - Windows 系统代理默认绕过 `*.local` 域名，访问局域网设备的 `.local` 主机名时不再经过代理

name: v0.21.46
body:
# oh-my-codex v0.21.46

## Summary

This patch release keeps generated native-agent instructions within the assigned scope and clarifies Git Master's task authority for history and remote writes.

## Fixed

- **ASSIGNMENT-SCOPED NATIVE AGENT OVERLAYS (#3989):** Generated posture and exact-model guidance no longer tell read-only or advisory roles to implement or always build. Specialist coverage, completion criteria, and verification requirements follow the assignment and repository/task requirements.
- **GIT MASTER AUTHORITY BOUNDARIES (#3997):** History rewrites and remote writes require task authority. Preserve unrelated dirty and untracked work without stashing, resetting, cleaning, or overwriting it; split independent concerns while keeping a behavior's required tests and support files together.

## Compatibility

No breaking API changes. Release-coupled metadata was already synchronized to `0.21.46` on dev by #3993; the release branch does not bump those surfaces again.

## Verification

- `npm ci` — passed.
- `npm run build` — passed.
- `npm test` — passed on the subsequent full run: all 475 Node test files and the generated catalog and prompt-inventory checks completed. An earlier attempt exceeded the command timeout without a final summary.
- `npm run check:no-unused` — passed.
- `npm run lint` — passed across 900 files; Biome emitted the existing `linter.rules.recommended` deprecation notice, with no fixes applied.
- Focused `native-config.test.js` regression suite — passed: 36 passed, 0 failed.
- Focused `codex-hooks.test.js` regression suite — passed: 74 passed, 1 skipped, 0 failed.
- Release-coupled version synchronization — passed: `node dist/scripts/check-version-sync.js --tag v0.21.46` and `cargo metadata --locked --format-version 1 --no-deps` report all six OMX workspace crates as `0.21.46`.

name: v0.21.45
body:
# oh-my-codex v0.21.45

## Summary

This patch release fixes `omx doctor` falsely reporting an unsafe trust migration for an unchanged foreign Codex hook group whose matcher is the empty string (#3984).

## Fixed

- **EMPTY FOREIGN HOOK MATCHER TRUST (#3985, fixes #3984):** Preserve any string matcher, including `""`, in the foreign hook trust hash input. Previously the truthiness check omitted an empty matcher, causing the calculated hash to differ from Codex's stored trust hash and `omx doctor` to report `unsafe_managed_removal` for an unchanged trusted hook group.

The fix targets the empty-matcher hash mismatch. The separately reported SessionEnd outlier is not addressed.

## Compatibility

No breaking API changes. Release-coupled metadata was already synchronized to `0.21.45` on dev by #3982; the release does not bump those surfaces again.

## Verification

- `npm ci` — passed.
- `npm run build` — passed.
- `npm test` — passed, including runtime build/tests, all 475 Node test files, generated catalog checks, and prompt-invariant checks.
- `npm run check:no-unused` — passed.
- `npm run lint` — passed across 900 files; Biome reported the existing `linter.rules.recommended` deprecation notice.

## Contributors

Thanks to [@Yeachan-Heo](https://github.com/Yeachan-Heo) for contributing to this release.

**Full Changelog**: [`v0.21.44...v0.21.45`](https://github.com/Yeachan-Heo/oh-my-codex/compare/v0.21.44...v0.21.45)

name: v5.1.58
body:
Runs on senpi 2026.11.2-1: Claude subscription sign-in works again. ([#12126](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12126))

**A timed-out or cancelled ultimate-browsing template gives its browser a graceful quit.** On macOS/Linux the executor runs each Playwright template in its own session and, on timeout or cancellation (Ctrl-C), sends SIGTERM to the template's process group and waits up to 5 s before SIGKILL, so Chrome can quit cleanly and remove its macOS code-sign clone and temp profile instead of being orphaned. The bundled omowright browser engine is pinned at the release whose pipe-launched browsers also get a graceful quit (SIGTERM, then SIGKILL after a grace period) when the engine closes them. ([#12068](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12068))

### Fixed

- The builtin `dev-browser` skill's macOS/Linux standalone command now runs a release step before `server.sh`. When nothing answers on 9222, it sends SIGTERM to whatever holds 9223, waits up to 5 s, and sends SIGKILL only to survivors. dev-browser's `start-server.ts` then finds the port free and never reaches its `kill -9`, so a browser gets its clean exit and does not leak per-launch state such as the macOS Chrome code-sign clone. A running server on 9222 is left alone, and the step does nothing when `curl` or `lsof` is missing. It works the same under bash and zsh. The upstream fix is SawyerHood/dev-browser#146. ([#12071](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12071), part of [#12067](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/12067))
- A delegated task now runs only on the models designated for it (its category's or agent's model chain). It never falls back to the parent session's model, whatever the failure: a usage limit, a missing or rejected sign-in, a content-policy refusal or an overload on every designated model ends the task with `failure_kind: "model_chain_exhausted"` and an error listing each model it tried and why, including any reset time the provider reported. This applies to every category and to workflow nodes. A `categories.<name>.provider_lock` key left in `omo.json` is ignored. ([#12006](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/12006), [#11781](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11781)) ([#12010](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12010))
- Keep an unacknowledged task-host session close reachable by teardown so detaching
  releases its transport instead of leaving the connection open until the RPC deadline. ([#11931](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11931))

### Changed

- The macOS (darwin-arm64) EQ.omo goldens for E21-E24 are re-recorded against senpi 2026.10.31-2, and recording now refuses a golden that carries a host-only notice or terminal event, so a machine-specific row can no longer be committed as the expected output. ([#12056](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12056), fixes [#12054](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/12054))

### Added

- The device service SDK (`@oh-my-opencode/device-service-core`) can download, verify and install the OmO device service and run its start-up bootstrap: the release signature is checked with the repository's strict Ed25519 helper against a compiled-in release key, every file against the signed checksums, and the release lands in the service's state dir only after every check passed. Nothing calls it yet, and the release key is a placeholder until it is published. ([#12052](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12052))

name: CC Switch v4.0.24
body:
# CC Switch v4.0.24

本版本在授权中心加了「登录时自动打开浏览器」开关，关掉后登录账号只复制登录链接，由你自己选浏览器打开，适合每个账号用独立浏览器环境的用户。另外修复了 Claude Code、Claude Desktop 经路由用 GPT 6.1 Sol / Terra 时 max 思考档位被降成 xhigh、DeepSeek Harness 选了支持 PDF 输入的模型后第三方供应商全部不显示、WSL 上 CC Switch 启动就退出、Codex 的 Chat 供应商重开「支持思考等级」后思考档位发不出去等问题。4.0 完整的更新内容请见 [v4.0 发布说明](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.4-zh.md)。

**[English →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.24-en.md) | [日本語版 →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.24-ja.md)**

---

## 新增

### 登录账号时可以只复制链接

以前在授权中心登录账号，一律用系统默认浏览器打开登录页。用 AdsPower 这类工具给每个账号单独开浏览器环境的话，登录会落到错误的浏览器里。

现在授权中心顶部多了「登录时自动打开浏览器」开关，Claude、ChatGPT、Copilot、xAI、Antigravity、Kimi、DeepSeek 账号登录都受它控制，包括在添加供应商表单里发起的登录。关掉后：

- 点登录只把登录链接复制到剪贴板，在你要用的浏览器里打开、登录并同意授权，CC Switch 会自动更新。
- 需要输入验证码的登录不再自动复制验证码，免得把剪贴板里的链接顶掉。
- 等待登录时可以点「复制登录链接」再复制一次，打开登录页的按钮不显示。

Windows 上 Claude Code 会自己打开浏览器，开关关掉时 CC Switch 会让它只输出登录链接。

开关默认打开，只记在这台电脑上，不随云同步。

**预设：** A6API 改用新域名 a6api.vip。

---

## 修复

- **Claude Code、Claude Desktop 经路由连 OpenAI 格式的上游、模型是 gpt-6.1-sol 或 gpt-6.1-terra 时，max 思考档位被降成 xhigh 发出**（[#9122](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9122)）。现在 GPT 5.6 及以后的版本，不带后缀或带 sol、terra、luna、astra 后缀的模型都保留 max；pro、codex、mini 等其他后缀仍按 xhigh 发。
- **DeepSeek Harness 从拉取到的模型列表里选了支持 PDF 输入的模型后，第三方供应商全部不显示**（[#9116](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9116)）。DeepSeek Harness 的模型输入类型只认文字和图片，写进去一个 PDF 就会让这一条配置整体失效。现在只写文字和图片。
- **WSL 上 CC Switch 启动后直接退出，报托盘图标「Permission denied」**（[#9021](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9021)、[#9020](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9020)）。Linux 的托盘图标改为放在应用的缓存目录。
- **Codex 的 Chat 供应商关掉再打开「支持思考等级」后，选的思考档位不再发给上游**（[#8998](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/8998)、[#8954](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8954)）。GitHub Copilot 等上游因此收不到任何思考档位。以前保存过的供应商不用重新编辑，也会恢复正常。
- **DeepSeek Harness 的「DeepSeek 官方登录」卡片写着「用 Claude 账号登录」**（[#9058](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9058)）。现在是「用 DeepSeek 账号登录」。

---

## 致谢

感谢 @gddg（WSL 托盘）、@guishiw（Codex 思考等级）、@iSanae233（DeepSeek 登录文案）的贡献。

感谢 @Xinyu-Li-1997、@clickwzy、@mhsbz、@ggbdpq 报告问题、提供复现信息和修复思路。

完整的技术细节请见 [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)。

name: BrowserSkill Extension 0.4.1
body:
BrowserSkill 0.4.1 coordinates the CLI/daemon, browser extension and DSH plugin.

### Changed

- **Shared-control default:** new CLI and DSH sync calls select `target` policy.
  DOM actions can reuse the returned control context across completed actions
  and supplementary reads; unrelated page updates no longer require a full-page
  resync. Human intervention or navigation revokes control. Use `--expect` / DSH
  `expect` to protect observed business facts. Scripts, untargeted keys and visual
  actions still require the sync's `--observation` / `observationId` and strict
  observation checks. Select `--policy strict` / `policy: "strict"` on the first
  sync to retain the one-action-per-context workflow; later syncs and steps
  preserve that session's policy.
- CLI/daemon and extension now use protocol 1.8. The new target policy requires
  both peers to support 1.8; update the CLI, running daemon, extension and DSH
  plugin together rather than relying on a successful mixed-version connection.
- DOM references remain attached to the same nodes across supplementary
  observations. Removed nodes are not silently replaced, and navigation
  invalidates the document's refs. DOM actions can wait for an existing target
  to become ready within their timeout without replaying input.

### Fixed

- Interaction capture initializes on ordinary HTTP intranet pages and their
  child frames when `crypto.randomUUID()` is unavailable. A compatible UUID
  fallback restores the frame coverage needed for shared control.
- Shared-control synchronization waits for cancelled observation thumbnails to
  settle. Viewport capture reads have a 10-second deadline with separate bounded
  cleanup; reaching that deadline returns `timeout` (exit 4) with screenshot-specific
  guidance. Browser/CDP capture failures remain `cdp_failed` (exit 3).
- Completed inputs retain their successful receipts when they navigate, including
  clicks, Enter submissions, drag submissions, and forms submitted after filling
  or selecting a value. After navigation, synchronize before the next action.
- CLI cancellation is armed before sending a browser command, so an immediate
  Ctrl-C can cancel the operation and return its outcome instead of terminating silently.
- Pointer hit tests stay within the target's document, and human input during
  frame changes continues to revoke control without discarding completed actions.
- Windows daemon startup errors distinguish verified Job Object restrictions,
  unverified breakaway failures, executable access failures, partial breakaway
  and resume failures, with recovery guidance for the actual failure stage.
- DSH-injected messages use native durable-format v4 plugin sources while
  retaining the legacy source shape for older formats.

### Removed

- Automatic native Agent Window tab groups and the `tabGroups` permission, to
  prevent new `BrowserSkill` groups from accumulating across browsers through
  Chrome sync. Existing saved groups are not deleted; page control indicators,
  background window behavior and user-tab routing remain available.

### Upgrade

1. Finish active tasks, install CLI 0.4.1 and restart the running daemon.
2. Install extension 0.4.1 before upgrading the DSH plugin to 0.4.1. Store review
   can delay availability; verify the installed extension, not just its submission.
3. Restart the DSH profile and invoke `/browser-skill` again, or start a new CLI
   agent conversation to load the updated skill. Custom tool integrations need
   the new observation and expectation fields for target-policy actions.
4. Check `bsk --version`, `bsk status` and `bsk doctor`; the running daemon and
   extension should both report protocol 1.8.

Full changelog: https://github.com/Tencent/BrowserSkill/blob/b8f2d4f0fa35c8c7c866229e1cf3b3329ae39de5/CHANGELOG.md
